def generated_builder(feature_cache, extra):
    objective = feature_cache["objective"]  # shape (B, N)
    gap = objective[:, :, None] - objective[:, None, :]  # shape (B, N, N): obj_i - obj_j
    mask = gap > 0  # True where i is loser (worse), j is winner (better)
    b_idx, loser_idx, winner_idx = mask.nonzero(as_tuple=True)  # pairs where loser_obj > winner_obj
    gap_scores = gap[b_idx, loser_idx, winner_idx]  # positive gaps

    ranks = torch.empty_like(sorted_indices, dtype=torch.long)
    ranks[sorted_indices] = torch.arange(1, gap_scores.size(0) + 1, device=gap_scores.device)

        winner_idx = winner_idx[topk_indices]
        loser_idx = loser_idx[topk_indices]

    return PrefBatch(
        mode="pairwise",
        pair_idx=(b_idx, winner_idx, loser_idx),
        weight=weights,

def generated_builder(feature_cache, extra):
    rank = feature_cache['rank']  # shape: (B, N)
    objective = feature_cache['objective']
    obj_range = feature_cache['instance_obj_range']  # shape: (B,)
    B, N = rank.shape
    max_pairs = int(extra.get('max_pairs', 16))

    # Select the top k winners per batch instance (k=1)
    topk_winner = rank.topk(k=1, largest=False)  # indices of best (lowest) rank per batch
    winner_idx = topk_winner.indices.squeeze(1)  # shape: (B,)

    # Create loser candidate mask: those whose rank is > winner rank and within band (e.g. rank_diff <= 5)
    band = 5
    winner_rank = rank[torch.arange(B), winner_idx].unsqueeze(1)  # (B,1)
    rank_diff = rank - winner_rank  # (B,N)
    loser_mask = (rank_diff > 0) & (rank_diff <= band)  # (B,N)

    # Get pair indices from mask
    b_idx, loser_idx = loser_mask.nonzero(as_tuple=True)
    winner_idx_expanded = winner_idx[b_idx]

    # Compute gap for candidates: gap = (obj_loser - obj_winner) normalized by instance obj range
    obj_winner = objective[b_idx, winner_idx_expanded]  # (P,)
    obj_loser = objective[b_idx, loser_idx]  # (P,)
    gap = obj_loser - obj_winner  # positive gaps only as loser worse than winner
    # Normalize gap by instance range with clamp to avoid div0
    obj_range_inst = obj_range[b_idx]
    eps = 1e-8
    norm_gap = gap / (obj_range_inst + eps)  # (P,)

    # Bandpass weight emphasizing mid-range gaps: weight = clamp(1 - abs(norm_gap - center)/width, 0, 1)
    center = 0.5  # center of bandpass
    width = 0.5
    weight = 1 - torch.abs(norm_gap - center) / width
    weight = torch.clamp(weight, min=0.0, max=1.0)

    # Cap number of pairs by max_pairs, selecting those with highest weight
    if weight.numel() > max_pairs:
        topk_idx = torch.topk(weight, k=max_pairs, largest=True, sorted=False).indices
        b_idx = b_idx[topk_idx]
        winner_idx_expanded = winner_idx_expanded[topk_idx]
        loser_idx = loser_idx[topk_idx]
        weight = weight[topk_idx]

    return PrefBatch(mode='pairwise', pair_idx=(b_idx, winner_idx_expanded, loser_idx), weight=weight, meta={'builder': 'top_gap_bandpass_002'})

def generated_builder(feature_cache, extra):
    rank = feature_cache['rank']  # shape: (B, N)
    objective = feature_cache['objective']
    obj_range = feature_cache['instance_obj_range']  # shape: (B,)
    B, N = rank.shape
    max_pairs = int(extra.get('max_pairs', 16))

    # Select the top k winners per batch instance (k=1)
    topk_winner = rank.topk(k=1, largest=False)  # indices of best (lowest) rank per batch
    winner_idx = topk_winner.indices.squeeze(1)  # shape: (B,)

    # Create loser candidate mask: those whose rank is > winner rank and within band (e.g. rank_diff <= 5)
    band = 5
    winner_rank = rank[torch.arange(B), winner_idx].unsqueeze(1)  # (B,1)
    rank_diff = rank - winner_rank  # (B,N)
    loser_mask = (rank_diff > 0) & (rank_diff <= band)  # (B,N)

    # Get pair indices from mask
    b_idx, loser_idx = loser_mask.nonzero(as_tuple=True)
    winner_idx_expanded = winner_idx[b_idx]

    # Compute gap for candidates: gap = (obj_loser - obj_winner) normalized by instance obj range
    obj_winner = objective[b_idx, winner_idx_expanded]  # (P,)
    obj_loser = objective[b_idx, loser_idx]  # (P,)
    gap = obj_loser - obj_winner  # positive gaps only as loser worse than winner
    # Normalize gap by instance range with clamp to avoid div0
    obj_range_inst = obj_range[b_idx]
    eps = 1e-8
    norm_gap = gap / (obj_range_inst + eps)  # (P,)

    # Bandpass weight emphasizing mid-range gaps: weight = clamp(1 - abs(norm_gap - center)/width, 0, 1)
    center = 0.5  # center of bandpass
    width = 0.5
    weight = 1 - torch.abs(norm_gap - center) / width
    weight = torch.clamp(weight, min=0.0, max=1.0)

    # Cap number of pairs by max_pairs, selecting those with highest weight
    if weight.numel() > max_pairs:
        topk_idx = torch.topk(weight, k=max_pairs, largest=True, sorted=False).indices
        b_idx = b_idx[topk_idx]
        winner_idx_expanded = winner_idx_expanded[topk_idx]
        loser_idx = loser_idx[topk_idx]
        weight = weight[topk_idx]

    return PrefBatch(mode='pairwise', pair_idx=(b_idx, winner_idx_expanded, loser_idx), weight=weight, meta={'builder': 'top_gap_bandpass_002'})
